SRC_HWPX = '/root/renewal_playbook.hwpx'

CSV_PATH = '/root/followups.csv'

    data = json.load(f)

    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        followups.append(row)

# --- Extract HWPX ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC_HWPX, 'r') as z:
    z.extractall(WORK_DIR)
    original_names = z.namelist()

# --- Register namespaces to prevent ns0/ns1 mangling ---
ns_hp = 'http://www.hancom.co.kr/hwpml/2010/HWPML'
ns_opf = 'http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf'
ET.register_namespace('hp', ns_hp)
ET.register_namespace('opf', ns_opf)

NS = {'hp': ns_hp, 'opf': ns_opf}

# Helper to find paragraphs by text content
def find_paragraphs_containing(root, text_fragment):
    """Return list of (paragraph_element, full_text) matching text_fragment."""
    matches = []
    for p in root.iter(f'{{{ns_hp}}}p'):
        full_text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter(f'{{{ns_hp}}}t'))
        if text_fragment in full_text:
            matches.append((p, full_text))
    return matches

def remove_linesegarray(p_elem):
    """Remove <hp:linesegarray> children from a paragraph."""
    for child in list(p_elem):
        if child.tag == f'{{{ns_hp}}}linesegarray':
            p_elem.remove(child)

# --- Mapping of old -> new values for simple text replacement ---
old_to_new = {
    '이전담당자': data['owner_name'],
    '2025-04-01 ~ 2025-04-15': f"{data['window_start']} ~ {data['window_end']}",
    'Standard-18M': data['band'],
    'ops-old@northwind.example': data['escalation_email'],
    '기존 메모를 새 메모로 바꾸세요.': data['note'],

def process_xml_file(xml_path):

    root = tree.getroot()

    # 1. Simple text replacements across all text nodes
    for old_val, new_val in old_to_new.items():
        # Find all paragraphs containing this text
        for p, full_text in find_paragraphs_containing(root, old_val):

            for t in p.iter(f'{{{ns_hp}}}t'):
                if t.text and old_val in t.text:
